items.title: Implement Crown Rush v2 state machine and traversal/combat integration (PLAN-002)
problem_evidence: Current movement lacks distinctive Crown Rush mechanics required by W2 gate.
items.hypothesis: Implementing ground/air dash, charge window, hit resolution, and trail state machine delivers core action feel.
items.expected_metric_delta: W2 Crown Rush state tests PASS
acceptance_checks: Crown Rush state transitions (ground/air dash, charge, cooldown) execute deterministically.
Input buffering and coyote time preserve fluid controls.
Unit tests cover state machine edge cases and boundary conditions.
human_checks: Verify Crown Rush control feel on keyboard and gamepad.
risks: Collision response during dash phase requires careful box intersection logic.

items.title: Rebuild original custom art, UI presentation, and audio soundscape (PLAN-003)
problem_evidence: Current visuals use placeholder/generic assets not tailored for Crown Kingdom identity.
items.hypothesis: Replacing all visible assets with cohesive custom pixel art, responsive UI, and audio creates a premium slice.
items.expected_metric_delta: W4 Art and Audio cohesion checks PASS
acceptance_checks: All character sprites, tilesets, and background layers use cohesive custom art.
UI displays clear HUD, menu, and dialog styling without placeholder text.
Audio engine plays sound effects and music tracks smoothly.
human_checks: Visual aesthetic and audio cohesion self-review.
risks: Asset loading performance on slower connections.

items.title: Build Goldenwind Forest Stage 1 & Stage 2 handcrafted levels (PLAN-004)
problem_evidence: Current level geometry is a basic test room without exploration depth.
items.hypothesis: Authored stage design with platforming challenges and secret routes provides engaging exploration.
acceptance_checks: Goldenwind Forest Stage 1 and Stage 2 feature distinct level layouts.
Hazards, collectibles, and secrets are placed intentionally across stages.
human_checks: Pacing and level progression manual check.

items.title: Implement Broken Throne boss fight, ending sequence, and save system (PLAN-005)
problem_evidence: No boss encounter or save state progression exists.
items.hypothesis: Adding a boss fight phase machine, win condition, ending screen, and LocalStorage save system completes game loop.
acceptance_checks: Broken Throne boss fight features telegraphs, attack patterns, and phase changes.
Defeating the boss triggers ending sequence and saves progress.
Save file integrity and load recovery operate reliably.
human_checks: Boss combat mechanics and save/load persistence manual verification.
risks: Boss state desynchronization or save corruption.

items.title: Execute browser E2E test suite and final user acceptance signoff (PLAN-006)
problem_evidence: Full browser end-to-end integration and final user acceptance must be proven for W5.
items.hypothesis: Running comprehensive Playwright browser verification and getting explicit user signoff proves W5 slice quality.
items.expected_metric_delta: W5 Full Browser Flow & User Acceptance PASS
acceptance_checks: Complete start-to-end playthrough succeeds in browser without console errors.
User explicitly signs off on final slice experience.
risks: Browser-specific rendering or input edge cases.
